figures.caption: Fig. 3. Qualitative segmentation results on BUSI test set. Columns: input image, ground truth, prediction, RAG attention map, overlay. Green=TP, Red=FP, Blue=FN. High attention regions correlate with textural lesion boundaries, demonstrating clinically coherent focus.
Fig. 1. RadiomicNet architecture. The Radiomics Attention Gate (RAG) fuses handcrafted texture features with deep skip connections at each decoder stage, providing ante-hoc interpretability.
